page.overview:
Who is Shtrom Jr.?

Shtrom Jr. is a reptilian-like alien with yellow and green skin, grey gloves and boots, and a green mohawk. On his back is what appears to be a jetpack and two pipes attached to the back of his head.

Shtrom Jr. moves very fast, using his speargun for long-range attacks, shooting several harpoons in quick succession as well as being able to perform a rolling jump into a drop kick.

Shtrom Jr. appears as an enemy in Namco X Capcom and Project X Zone 2 alongside other Captain Commando foes.
